senses.gloss: m. (כחש) contradiction, incongruity in details of legal evidence.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 15:5:4">Y. Yeb. XV, 15ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ה׳ עדות בתוך עדות</he> an incongruity in the statements of witnesses concerning the details of the main fact to be ascertained; <he>ה׳ עדות לאחר עדות</he> concerning circumstances subsequent to the main fact.
